lines: Before we venture out into the Let's take your ship for a spin.
Drift around and get a feel for your ship.
Loop around a little. There's no rush.
Charging burns energy, but it's the only way through dust.
Some dust has grown in. Charge into it.
Dust takes the colour of a musical role.
Each colour carves differently. Bright dust gives way easily...
...while deep, heavy colours push back. Keep charging.
Nicely done! A path is opening.
Welcome back! Hold your confirm button to skip ahead.
Running on empty! Out here your tank refills, but in the music it won't.
Ease off Charge to save energy.
Heavy dust takes more effort. Keep charging and it'll break.
Or try a brighter colour first.
